grades.main_gap: The core lemma — finiteness of the set of primes appearing (Lemma 2) — is admitted open, with only a vague proof sketch; backward extension to all n (Lemma 7) is also unproven, and Lemmas 3 and 5 are only sketched.
grades.notes: Correct and useful reduction of the greedy rule to multiples of minimal hitting-set products, and Lemma 1 is properly proved. Conditional on the unproven finiteness of primes, the stabilization and merge-of-progressions argument for eventual periodicity is essentially sound. However, the problem's crux (finiteness) and the extension to all n are absent, so only partial progress.
